overview: The Mid Caverns form the heart of Paludal’s subterranean network.
details: Smugglers use hidden alcoves to move goods toward Shadow Haven, while bandits maintain fortified positions deeper within.
hooks: A smuggler safehouse is found abandoned, its supplies untouched.
Shadow anomalies distort sound and light in the deeper tunnels.
Bandits prepare a coordinated assault on smuggler routes.
